description: Sabotages for report-io-test-tail.ps1, which joins the file-I/O tests' executions to the runner's disk counters (CHECKLIST.md M34.28), judged by test-report-io-test-tail.ps1. Run with tools/run-sabotage.ps1 -Manifest tools/sabotage-io-test-tail.json -CargoCommand tools/sabotage-io-test-tail-runner.cmd; see tools/README-sabotage.md.

sabotages.name: the counters' local time is taken as UTC
sabotages.why: typeperf stamps samples in local time; read as UTC, every sample is off by the time-zone bias, so a slow execution is compared with the disk hours away from it.

sabotages.name: the _Total average is read as a drive
sabotages.why: The _Total instance averages the drives, so a stall on one drive would be read twice and an average could be called a stall on a drive it never reached.

sabotages.name: slowness ignores the test's own median
sabotages.why: A test that always takes seconds would be listed as slow on every execution, burying the executions that are slow for that test.

sabotages.name: a sample at the threshold is not a stall
sabotages.why: The threshold is a percentile of the samples, so it is itself a sample; excluding it leaves the worst sample in a short series below the line.

sabotages.name: control: the peak latency is taken with LINQ
sabotages.why: A control: the same maximum computed another way.
